slot_packages: SELECT slot,collection_role,disposition,transaction_status,COUNT(*) AS packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement) AS pump_referencing_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_metadata_bytes IS NULL) AS missing_status_metadata FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY slot,collection_role,disposition,transaction_status
layer_counts: SELECT 'bronze' AS layer,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze UNION ALL SELECT 'silver',COUNT(*) FROM silver ORDER BY layer
input_evidence: SELECT 'bronze' AS layer,collection_source_id,input_kind,receipt_evidence,slice_class,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'silver',collection_source_id,input_kind,receipt_evidence,slice_class,COUNT(*) FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
trade_coverage: SELECT slot,collection_role,is_buy,units_binding_status,COUNT(*) AS recorded_trades,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_decimals IS NULL) AS missing_base_unit_context,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_quote_decimals FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY slot,collection_role,is_buy,units_binding_status
mint_sides: SELECT mint,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS TRUE) AS admitted_buys,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS FALSE) AS admitted_sells,COUNT(DISTINCT units_decimals) AS recorded_decimal_scales,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_decimals IS NULL) AS missing_base_unit_context FROM silver GROUP BY mint ORDER BY mint
balance_coverage: SELECT slot,collection_role,COUNT(*) AS packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state='VALUE' AND len(token_balance_observations)>0) AS packages_with_recorded_balances,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state='VALUE' AND len(token_balance_observations)=0) AS empty_or_not_recorded_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_balance_observations_state<>'VALUE') AS unavailable_projection_packages,SUM(len(token_balance_observations)) AS recorded_balance_observations FROM bronze GROUP BY slot,collection_role ORDER BY slot,collection_role
parent_binding: SELECT COUNT(*) AS silver_records,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bronze b WHERE b.record_sha256=s.bronze_record_sha256 AND b.slot=s.slot AND b.transaction_index=s.transaction_index AND b.raw_sha256=s.raw_sha256 AND b.collection_source_id=s.collection_source_id)) AS exact_bronze_parents FROM silver s
trades: SELECT record_ordinal,collection_batch_id,collection_source_id,collection_role,slot,transaction_index,is_buy,mint,transaction_status,token_amount_raw_u64,sol_amount_raw_u64,spendable_quote_in_raw_u64,min_tokens_out_raw_u64,units_decimals,units_decimals_evidence,units_event_token_amount_decimal,outer_index,instruction_inner_order,event_inner_order,event_association,cpi_signer,cpi_writable,quote_mint_identity,quote_decimals,raw_sha256,bronze_record_sha256,record_sha256 FROM silver ORDER BY record_ordinal
rejected_profiles: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,transaction_status,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.buy_source_diagnostics') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT p.slot,p.transaction_index,p.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.admission') AS admission,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.full_instruction_error.reason') AS reason FROM p,json_each(p.diagnoses) d ORDER BY p.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
sell_profile_outcomes: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_sell_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT p.slot,p.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM p,json_each(p.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
nested_buy_outcomes: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_nested_buy_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT p.slot,p.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM p,json_each(p.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
buy_variant_outcomes: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_variant_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT p.slot,p.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM p,json_each(p.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
exact_quote_outcomes: WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_exact_quote_v2_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT p.slot,p.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM p,json_each(p.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
missing_context: SELECT 'bronze' AS layer,disposition,observed_at_state,actionable_at_state,execution_opportunity_at_state,name_state,ticker_state,launch_at_state,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'silver',transaction_status,observed_at_state,actionable_at_state,execution_opportunity_at_state,name_state,ticker_state,launch_at_state,COUNT(*) FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
